name: Catherine Greig (2011)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. Generic older woman with white-blonde hair (the only trait used); face and clothing are neutral and generic. She is living and served her sentence: never mocked, no 'gangster's moll' framing.
rules: Shown only in everyday, non-sensational moments (walking, feeding the stray cat). Every shot she appears in carries 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'.
